summary: Find the separated 8-connected multicolor pieces against the modal background. Color 1 is each piece body. Every marker color occurring exactly twice on different pieces defines one docking edge: infer the first marker's supported outward cardinal direction, place the other marker one cell beyond it, propagate placements across the marker-color tree, paint every original cell without overlap, and crop the completed assembly. A marker color occurring once is preserved but creates no edge.
